name: io.github.Flosk6/spawner
title: Spawner
description: Preview environments on your self-hosted Spawner server: a copy of your app for each git branch

environmentVariables.name: SPAWNER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your Spawner server's dashboard, such as https://spawner.preview.example.com. Without it, the server of spawner login

environmentVariables.name: SPAWNER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API token (spn_...), from spawner token create or the dashboard. Without it, the token of spawner login
